option_relations.rationale: The option directly matches the label of the leaf disease
Gastric outlet obstruction is a symptom that can be caused by Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome
Peptic stricture of the stomach is not directly related to Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome
Neoplasm of the stomach is not directly related to Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome
Annular pancreas, diabetic gastroparesis, internal hernia, and duodenal bezoar are alternative causes of obstruction, not directly related to Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome
Peptic ulcer disease and duodenal tumors are not directly related to Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome
Scleroderma and other collagen or vascular disorders are not directly related to Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome
Vascular compression due to a reduced aortomesenteric angle is a subtype or mechanism of Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome
